hypothesis: Rejecting short primary flags removes the negative short-scale bulk while retaining most large-winner paths.
unique_change: After the unchanged detector selects its primary candidate, reject executable short-scale primaries. Do not promote an alternate candidate.
retention_definition: Strictly more than half of baseline MFE >= 0.5 paths must survive, matched by symbol, signal date and entry signal ID; equality is failure.
constraints: Only exclude_short_scale changes. Preserve detector ranking, thresholds, exits, costs, universe and training boundary.
All inherited baseline training gates remain mandatory; the structural hypothesis does not relax them.
Require candidate/trade subset reconciliation against the archived baseline before interpreting results.
No parameter search, alternate-scale reselection, or exposed temporal-test access.
promotion: Passing training gates only permits preregistering dependence-aware significance and overlap diagnostics; no live or holdout qualification.
failure_action: Stop this primary-scale restriction and its adjacent scale/threshold variants.
